partner_result_applied.application: weighted D-prime determinant packet remains valid for A=A0+T+sum tau_r v_r v_r^T when dense-tail norm plus supported spike cross-footprint is below the baseline minor gap; yields C(h)/(gap) on the actual final form

new_claims.statement: If a physical baseline triple has singular gap kappa and A=A0+T+L with ||T||op<=delta and local spectral footprint ||L[S,S]||op=eta, delta+eta<kappa, then ||p||inf<=6sqrt(pi)/(kappa-delta-eta). For L=sum tau_r v_r v_r^T, eta<=sum |tau_r|||v_r,S||^2.

For a weighted 3x3 cross-minor packet with I-row marginals h<3/4 and baseline minor gap kappa, dense-tail norm plus maximal supported spike cross-footprint Delta_V<kappa yields ||p||inf<=C(h)/(kappa-Delta_V), with continuity.
If B is no-tau-pivot and ||E||op<=delta then B+E is no-hat_tau for any hat_tau above max(tau+delta, tau+2delta(tau+sqrt(tau+tau^2))+2delta^2), and s3(B+E)>=s3(B)-delta.

exact_target_class_witness: For n>=12, Astar=2u1u1^T+2u2u2^T-2u3u3^T+tau vv^T with u1=(e1-e4)/sqrt2, u2=(e2-e5)/sqrt2, u3=(e3-e6)/sqrt2, v=1/sqrt(n)(1,...,1) has spectrum {2,2,-2,tau,0,...}. After any dense symmetric T with ||T||op<=1/4 and |tau|<=n/12, s3>=7/4 and ||p||inf<=12sqrt(pi); tau=+-n/12 is an unbounded fourth eigenvalue family.
dense_tail_nopivot_example: tau=1/16, delta=1/64: a no-1/16-pivot B with s3(B)>=65/64 plus any symmetric ||E||op<=1/64 becomes a no-1/8-pivot target matrix.
forbidden_shortcut_checked: Small operator norm was never interpreted as X^TEX uniformly small. Example E=delta e1e1^T and X1 uniform [R,R+1] gives X^TEX>=delta R^2. No post-rotation independence or independent convolution used.

In N3, combine entry bounds and exterior-cube mass before paying reciprocal local curvature; do not select one minor or assume a rank-three cut.
